question: In patients with metastatic colorectal cancer harboring BRAF V600E mutations, how does combination targeted therapy with a BRAF inhibitor plus an anti-EGFR agent (with or without a MEK inhibitor) compare to standard chemotherapy-based regimens (with or without anti-VEGF) in terms of overall survival, progression-free survival, and objective response rate?
expected_search_terms: BRAF V600E metastatic colorectal cancer BRAF inhibitor anti-EGFR overall survival progression-free survival response rate
BRAF inhibitor + EGFR inhibitor ± MEK inhibitor colorectal cancer clinical trial outcomes
metastatic colorectal cancer BRAF V600E chemotherapy bevacizumab comparison targeted therapy
